description: This file contains functions and types for serializing Protocol Buffers messages into the text format, including handling of extensions, special float values, and nested message structures. It implements a configurable marshaler for the protobuf text format.

classes.name: textWriter
classes.description: A writer that tracks indentation and formatting for protobuf text serialization.

classes.name: TextMarshaler
classes.description: Configurable marshaler for protobuf text format, supporting compact and expanded modes.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into text format, writing to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into a string in text format.

methods.name: MarshalText
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into text format, writing to an io.Writer (uses default marshaler).

methods.name: MarshalTextString
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into a string in text format (uses default marshaler).

methods.name: CompactText
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into a compact, single-line text format.

methods.name: CompactTextString
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into a compact string in text format.
